name: Klaven's Tower
summary: Agent Kearnen watches Klaven's Tower from a camp in Westfall. Strange shipments and altered guards point to a threat inside the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Stakeout in Westfall
sections.body: Near the river at Westfall's southeastern edge, Klaven's Tower rises north of the Dagger Hills. The Defias Brotherhood claims the stone spire, though its human thieves and brigands are common across the plains. Agent Kearnen has watched it alone for weeks and noticed strange developments. A bizarre shipment recently came straight from Duskwood's shadowed woods. Monstrous, deformed sentries escorted it, unlike any ordinary highwaymen.

sections.title: The Spire and the Spiked Guard
sections.body: Klaven Mortwake commands the tower, where oddly altered sentries breathe in harsh, labored gasps. A hulking zombie among the shambling guards carries the Defias Tower Key, and taking it calls for silence and finesse. With the key, an operative can bypass the ground defenses, reach the stronghold's upper levels, and open the padlocked Duskwood Chest.

sections.title: Zanzil's Concoction
sections.body: Klaven Mortwake's personal journal links the Defias, the Venture Company, and the jungle trolls of Stranglethorn. The writings say the witch doctor Zanzil discovered an alchemical poison that can raise unthinking, obedient undead drones. For Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7, the discovery reveals the Defias's widening ambitions. Its agents need a firm understanding of poisons.

faq.answer: Klaven's Tower stands at Westfall's southeastern edge, near the river and north of the Dagger Hills. The Defias Brotherhood holds the fortified spire.

aliases: who is the rogue in westfall
faq.answer: Agent Kearnen works for Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. She has watched Klaven's Tower in secret for weeks from a nearby camp, tracking strange shipments and planning an infiltration.

faq.q: What makes the guards at Klaven's Tower unusual?
faq.answer: The tower's sentries are altered undead, unlike the Defias's usual human bandits. An exotic alchemical concoction shipped into Westfall made them mindless laborers.

faq.q: How does the Defias have undead servants?
faq.answer: The Defias obtained a specialized toxic brew from Zanzil, a jungle troll witch doctor in Stranglethorn Vale. The poison came through dealings with the Venture Company and turns living subjects into obedient drones.
Klaven Mortwake is a high-ranking Defias overseer at the tower. He oversaw dark shipments from Duskwood and kept a private journal about their sinister alchemy.

faq.q: Why does Mathias Shaw care about the recovered journal?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw needs useful intelligence on Defias alliances and dangerous foreign agents. Word that Zanzil's trolls can create undead through poison warns SI:7 of a grave threat to Stormwind, so the agency must train its operatives in venomcraft.

angles.text: As an Alliance rogue, you face a covert infiltration that calls for stealth, pickpocketing, lockpicking, and finding an enemy's physical weakness.
The Defias at Klaven's Tower have joined with jungle trolls and dark alchemy to threaten the kingdom. They are more than aggrieved masons.
As a human defender of Stormwind, you may be horrified to find former countrymen turned into mindless undead drones in Westfall.
